```{python}

from netzero_metrics.models import Area, EuiTarget, ProjectBuilding
from pydantic import BaseModel
from IPython.display import Markdown


def pydantic_model_to_markdown(model: BaseModel)-> str:
    def get_description(v): return v.description if v.description is not None else ""
    cols = "- " + "- ".join([f"**{k}**: {v.annotation}, {get_description(v)}\n" for k, v in model.model_fields.items()])
    text = f"""### {model.__name__} Columns

{cols}"""
    return text

models = [ProjectBuilding, Area, EuiTarget]
texts = [pydantic_model_to_markdown(model) for model in models]
text = "\n\n".join(texts)
Markdown(text)

```

    [grid(_area), grid(_bldg), grid(area), grid(eui_custom)],
    titles=["_area", "_bldg", "area", "eui_custom"]
